build_sampler: build a SamplingMethod sampler from args and task using the build_sampler static method
create_temperature_sampling: create a temperature-based sampling function with make_temperature_sampling using a custom temperature value
create_ratio_sampling: create a ratio-based sampling function with make_ratio_sampling using predefined ratios for datasets
add_sampling_arguments: add the sampling-method and sampling-temperature CLI arguments to an argparse parser via add_arguments
select_sampling_method: select a sampling function using sampling_method_selector based on the configured sampling method
